content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto allows creators to bypass traditional payment barriers and retain more profits. Conventional platforms can charge high fees, such as Gumroad’s 10% on every sale. In contrast, using NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee, which means more earnings for creators. The infrastructure we've developed ensures that creators have complete ownership and control over their sales without depending on restrictive platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The sovereign digital commerce stack leverages free and open-source tools to create a seamless selling experience. By using structures like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, creators can automate their sales and delivery processes. This infrastructure allows for instant product delivery and complete data ownership, ensuring that the creator retains full control of their business without ongoing subscription costs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you're an educator, designer, or software developer, the sovereign stack empowers you to sell your Notion templates without financial barriers. It’s ideal for those who want to maintain their sovereignty in commerce while tapping into a global market of crypto users eager for digital products.
No more platform fees; keep more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of multiple layers that work in harmony. Starting with GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting, it integrates with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets handles order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 manages file delivery. The final piece, NOWPayments, facilitates the crypto transactions, converting prices in USD at the moment of sale, ensuring real-time pricing accuracy for customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack. This stack allows you to host your products and process payments through crypto without relying on conventional platforms. NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to 0.5%, maximizing your profits and allowing full ownership of your sales infrastructure.
Retain full ownership of your digital products and data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those exploring options beyond mainstream platforms, consider how the Complete Builder Kit ($197) equips you with all necessary blueprints and templates to build your sovereign digital commerce stack. Related queries about selling ebooks and digital downloads without platform fees are addressed by leveraging this architecture.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
